deduplicate_documents: deduplicate a JSONL file by removing duplicate lines within documents using the deduplicate function
collect_hashes_with_HashesCollector: collect SHA1 hashes of document lines into a FlatHashSet using HashesCollector as a transformer
remove_duplicates_with_DuplicatesRemover: remove duplicate lines from documents by loading precomputed hash files with DuplicatesRemover
deduplicate_sharded_files: remove duplicates across multiple sharded JSONL files using remove_duplicates_sharded with a hashes directory
merge_hash_sets: merge two FlatHashSet instances to combine deduplication hashes and save the merged result
